description: Adds a tracked link with its own code for one location, building or staff member (up to 50). Renters who use it count for this partner, with the same two-months-free perk.

label.description: A name for the link, e.g. "King St location".

partner_key.description: The partner key from partner_claim_key. On REST send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" instead.

name: partner_create_sublink
title: Add a tracked link
